<!-- This script shows pattern in four local authorities(3 rural and 1 comparator) and Ceredigion-->

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)


```

## Step 1- Load master dataset
```{r load_master}
master <- read_csv("../data/processed/master_dataset.csv") %>%
  mutate(rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural", "Urban")))
# 3 rural Powys, ceredigion, pembrokshire and 1 urban swansea comparator
case_las <- c("Powys","Ceredigion","Pembrokeshire","Swansea")
N   <- nrow(master)
T20 <- floor(N * 0.20)
T10 <- floor(N * 0.10)

```

## Step 2- Domain table for four local authorities
```{r domain_table}
# Percent of LSOAs in worst 20% per domain
domain_cols <- c("wimd_2025_rank", "income_rank", "employment_rank",
                 "health_rank", "education_rank", "access_rank",
                 "housing_rank", "community_safety_rank", "physical_env_rank")

domain_labels <- c("WIMD Overall", "Income (22%)", "Employment (20%)",
                   "Health (15%)", "Education (14%)", "Access (10%)",
                   "Housing (9%)", "Community Safety (5%)", "Physical Env (5%)")

master %>%
  filter(la_name %in% case_las) %>%
  group_by(la_name) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(domain_cols),
                   ~round(100 * mean(.x <= T20, na.rm=TRUE), 1)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-la_name, names_to="Domain", values_to="pct") %>%
  mutate(Domain = factor(Domain, levels=domain_cols, labels=domain_labels)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=la_name, values_from=pct) %>%
  arrange(Domain)


```

## Step 3- Access/overall gap, ranked by sizes
```{r access_overall_gap}
# access overall gap,hidden access deprivation
master %>%
  filter(la_name %in% case_las) %>%
  group_by(la_name) %>%
   summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    pct_worst20_overall = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= T20), 1),
    pct_worst20_access  = round(100 * mean(access_rank    <= T20), 1),
    pct_worst20_housing = round(100 * mean(housing_rank   <= T20), 1),
    gap_access_overall  = round(pct_worst20_access - pct_worst20_overall, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(gap_access_overall))

```

## Step 4- In Ceredigion: Aberystwyth vs rural ceredigion
```{r aberystwyth}
# internal contrast within ceredigion
master %>%
  filter(la_name == "Ceredigion") %>%
  mutate(area_type = case_when(
    str_detect(lsoa_name, "Aberystwyth") ~ "Aberystwyth (Urban)",
    rural_urban == "Rural"               ~ "Rural Ceredigion",
    TRUE                                 ~ "Other Urban Ceredigion"
  )) %>%
  group_by(area_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm=TRUE),
    median_access_rank  = median(access_rank,    na.rm=TRUE),
    pct_worst20_access  = round(100 * mean(access_rank <= T20), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Step 5- Worst 20% in both access and housing
```{r dual_deprivation}
# Rural LSOAs in worst 20% on both access and housing
dual_deprived <- master %>%
  filter(
    rural_urban  == "Rural",
    access_rank  <= T20,
    housing_rank <= T20
  )

cat("Dual deprived rural LSOAs:", nrow(dual_deprived), "\n")
cat("% in worst 20% OVERALL:", round(100 * mean(dual_deprived$wimd_2025_rank <= T20), 1), "%\n")
cat("Median overall rank:", median(dual_deprived$wimd_2025_rank), "\n")

dual_deprived %>% count(la_name, sort=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct_of_total = round(100 * n / nrow(dual_deprived), 1))

```

## Step 6- Rural Urban in each case study authorities
```{r rural_urban_within_la}
master %>%
  filter(la_name %in% case_las) %>%
  group_by(la_name, rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    pct_worst20_overall = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= T20), 1),
    pct_worst20_access  = round(100 * mean(access_rank    <= T20), 1),
    pct_worst20_housing = round(100 * mean(housing_rank   <= T20), 1),
    pct_worst20_income  = round(100 * mean(income_rank    <= T20), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% arrange(la_name, rural_urban)

```

## Step 7- 189 invisible communities
```{r}
# 189 structurally invisible rural LSOA
invisible_lsoas <- master %>%
  filter(rural_urban    == "Rural",
         access_rank    <= T10,
         wimd_2025_rank >  T20) %>%
  arrange(access_rank_gap) %>%
  select(lsoa_name, la_name, wimd_2025_rank, access_rank, access_rank_gap)
cat("Total invisible communities:", nrow(invisible_lsoas))
# Top 20 most severely invisible
invisible_lsoas %>% slice_head(n = 20)

```

## Step 8- Invisible communities by local authority
```{r invisible_la_summary}
# areas most invisible communities
invisible_lsoas %>%
  count(la_name, sort=TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct_of_total = round(100 * n / nrow(invisible_lsoas), 1))


```
